title: A Misunderstood Heart
content:
After collecting the room key, Siddu and Sneha entered their hotel room.

The long journey had left both of them exhausted.

"I'll freshen up first," Sneha said.

Siddu nodded with a smile.

A few minutes later, while freshening up, Sneha noticed that one corner of the mirror had cracked. Not wanting anyone to get hurt, she instinctively reached out to remove the loose piece of broken glass.

The moment her fingers touched it...

"Ahh!"

A sharp cry escaped her lips.

Blood slowly trickled down her hand.

Hearing her scream, Siddu immediately rushed inside.

"Sneha!"

The moment he saw the cut on her hand, panic flashed across his face.

Without wasting another second, he hurried to the reception desk, collected the first-aid box, and rushed back to the room.

"Sit down," he said gently.

Sneha quietly obeyed.

Siddu carefully took her injured hand into his own and slowly cleaned the wound with iodine.

"It might sting a little," he said softly.

But strangely...

Sneha barely felt the pain.

Her attention was no longer on the wound.

It was on the warmth of Siddu's hand...

The concern in his eyes...

And the tenderness with which he cared for her.

After applying the antiseptic ointment, Siddu carefully wrapped a bandage around her hand.

"There..."

"You'll be fine now."

Sneha looked at him with a gentle smile.

"Thank you."

Siddu simply smiled.

The rest of the day passed beautifully.

Together, they explored the beautiful places of Jammu.

They admired the breathtaking mountains, clicked countless photographs, tasted local delicacies, laughed over the smallest things, and created memories they would never forget.

With every passing hour...

Their bond grew stronger.

As evening slowly turned into night, the city transformed into something even more beautiful.

The cool breeze...

The glowing streets...

The peaceful atmosphere...

Everything made Jammu feel magical.

After enjoying the night for some time, they finally returned to their hotel.

Both of them changed into comfortable clothes and sat down for dinner.

Sneha tried to eat using her injured hand.

The moment she lifted the spoon...

She winced in pain.

Siddu quietly noticed her struggle.

Without saying a word, he gently pulled her plate toward himself.

Sneha looked at him in confusion.

"What are you doing?"

Instead of answering, Siddu filled a spoon with food and held it in front of her.

"Open your mouth."

Sneha blinked in surprise.

"Siddu..."

"Your hand is injured," he said with a warm smile.

"Don't be stubborn."

Unable to refuse, she slowly opened her mouth.

Patiently, Siddu fed her one spoon after another.

Not once did he hesitate.

To him, it was the most natural thing in the world.

Every small gesture...

Every caring glance...

Every smile...

Made Sneha's heartbeat grow faster.

She couldn't stop looking at him.

After a few moments, Siddu noticed.

"What happened, Sneha?"

"Why are you staring at me?"

She quickly looked away and smiled shyly.

"Nothing..."

A brief silence followed.

Then she spoke softly.

"Thank you... for everything, Siddu."

He shook his head gently.

"There is no need to thank me."

"When someone is important to us, helping them comes naturally."

The words echoed inside Sneha's heart.

Important to us...

Her heartbeat suddenly quickened.

Did he really mean that?

Was she someone special to him?

The thought alone made her cheeks turn red.

Her heart refused to listen to her mind.

Before she could stop herself...

She slowly stood up.

Siddu looked at her in confusion.

"Sneha...?"

She walked toward him.

For a few silent moments...

She simply looked into his eyes.

Then...

Without saying a single word...

She gently placed a kiss on his forehead.

Time seemed to stop.

Siddu froze.

His eyes widened in complete surprise.

For several seconds...

He couldn't understand what had just happened.

Sneha slowly stepped back.

Her face burned with embarrassment, yet her heart felt strangely peaceful.

An awkward silence filled the room.

Finally, Siddu gathered himself and looked at her with genuine confusion.

"Sneha..."

"What... did you just do?"
